{{Quote|Welcome to Alliance.reb, the largest network service in the galaxy.|H. Voolai|<ref name="Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''</ref>}}
'''Alliance.reb''' was a communications network service that allowed users to send and receive messages and files through [[e-mail]]. Its administrators included [[H. Voolai]]. [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] used his network account to communicate with family, friends, fellow [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]], and various companies.
